ordered_actions: Inspect the real candidate-training and result-collection path without running a Pilot outcome.
Implement and adversarially test the minimum Pilot runner, GPU/cost accounting, missingness mapping and deterministic four-axis analysis.
Freeze a content-addressed DevelopmentPilotContractV1 with excluded seeds, bounded rounds, exact identities and a distinct fresh state before the first Pilot outcome.
Independently audit the frozen preflight and run the Pilot only if every identity, isolation, budget and lineage gate closes.
Seal the Pilot result and independently decide GO, NOT_READY or INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION from correctness, runtime, support, cost and analysis readiness only.
If and only if Pilot verdict is GO, freeze the exact Main tuple and start record required by the active master instruction.
stop_conditions: Any Pilot P0 or P1 finding
Any identity, environment, lineage, mount, permission or budget ambiguity
Any need to tune policy, Guard, BL coverage, thresholds or analysis from NDCG or relative Arm outcomes
